messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall (oncall-frontend) — elevated 5xx from gateway across region us-west-2. Alerts from synthetic checks and customers reporting 502/504.

oncall-frontend: saw the page, I'm on it. any recent deploys?

deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded to prod-frontend at 2026-03-15T10:12:05Z (rev: r21e8c)

sre-jordan: confirming spikes on envoy stats: cluster backend-api has ~30% TCP reset and envproxy downstream 5xx increased.

alex: digging into loadbalancer metrics, connection error rate up, 5xx started ~10:13:30 UTC. Might be route mismatch after yesterday's route weight tweak.

maya: I'm on logs. Envoy shows upstream reset and 'route not found' for some paths, also lots of retry attempts from retry policy.

oncall-frontend: can we disable global retries on the gateway while we investigate? That should reduce cascade.

sre-jordan: agreed. running command: `kubectl -n infra exec -it lb-config -- curl -X PATCH http://config-service/route -d '{\"retries\":0}'`

deploy-bot: config patch recorded (cfg-20260315-0925). Patching envoy config via xDS.

alex: rolling the change now. pushing a new route config with retries=0 and lowering max connections per host.

maya: after the patch, 5xx dropped ~40% in 30s. Still seeing some 502s.

sre-jordan: looking at circuit breaker stats: many upstream hosts in overflow (max_connections). We should increase the per-host limit or rebalance traffic.

oncall-frontend: can we weight traffic away from backend-api-canary? It looks like canary instances are old and flaky.

alex: changing weights: backend-api-primary -> 90%, backend-api-canary -> 10% -> moving to 99/1 now.

sre-jordan: apply weight change via `kubectl -n infra apply -f route-weight-override.yaml` (pushed).

maya: watching error rate per instance: canary is still flapping but total 5xx approaching normal. Initiating a restart of the canary pool.

oncall-frontend: trigger restart: `k rollout restart deployment/backend-api-canary -n prod`

deploy-bot: Restart queued, pods terminating... new pods coming up.

cs-emily: FYI a handful of customers reported failed requests in their dashboards. I'm drafting a status note: short degradation affecting inference calls in US-WEST for ~15m, retries disabled and rollback in progress.

maya: After restarts, canary stabilized, upstream resets ceased. 5xx is back to baseline.

sre-jordan: follow-up actions: 1) revert retry policy to configured default after 1h of stable traffic, 2) add automated circuit-breaker alert when >50% hosts tripping, 3) run a canary readiness probe audit.

oncall-frontend: adding to incident: incident-2026-03-15-gw-retries-cb. Assigning postmortem to SRE + Eng-frontend.

alex: root cause looks like a combination of a route weight change + conservative circuit-breaker thresholds + retry policy causing cascades. Will prepare a PR for safer rollout (gradual weight steps + health gating).

cs-emily: status update sent to affected customers. No PII. will reopen if more reports come in.

incident-bot: Incident resolved. Severity: sev2. Duration: 00:17:40. Oncall: oncall-frontend. Handed off to SRE for follow-up.

oncall-frontend: thanks team. I'll handoff to sre-jordan for the writeup and runbook updates.

sre-jordan: will own the postmortem. adding timeline and action items to ops board.

alex: quick question — which deploy caused the initial route change? I'll trace config history.

maya: config history shows manual change by eng-frontend lead at 2026-03-14T22:05:12Z. Notified them.

oncall-frontend: closing thread, reopen if regressions.
